No separately implemented components needed another owner to reconcile; the parent integrated its own modules.
The parent wrote the required test12.mjs and artifact validation found the expected entry file.
The parent covered probing, writing, local testing, and artifact placement; the failure was not an unowned end-to-end transition.
Parallel implementation was not blocked behind a mandatory preflight; the parent wrote code while the workflow ran.
Although the parent investigated before writing, the workflow ran concurrently and the serial control shows ordinary investigation is not a parallel coordination error.
The parent continued the indispensable implementation path; no separate auxiliary-worker allocation starved an unowned critical implementation path.
The workflow did create budget pressure, but the directly evidenced coordination boundary is the checkpoint-free retry of one stalled lens; broad fan-out alone is not retained.
The argparse lens was broad but eventually produced a report after retry; the specific fault is missing checkpoint transfer, not a single overlarge unfinished child assignment.

The child prompts contained the relevant source sketch, executable, no-python/no-deepdiff-source constraint, and lens-specific acceptance asks; no known task requirement was omitted at initial delegation.
Children owned research lenses rather than interoperating code components, so no cross-agent implementation contract was missing or produced incompatible artifacts.
No completed known finding is shown being transferred and then lost; the relevant absence occurred at retry initialization.
The completed child reports were large, but the parent did not receive an aggregate handoff and then fail to reduce it within a visible decision window.
No actor consumed a handoff describing a superseded workspace or decision state.
The child reports were compatible behavioral characterizations; no unresolved incompatible reports blocked or corrupted integration.
The parent did not make a normal whole-task completion presentation; the final response is empty after timeout, and official evaluation rather than unsupported acceptance establishes pass.

retained_patterns.reason: The original argparse-and-bigint child was interrupted and replaced by a retry whose starting prompt was the original full task rather than a checkpointed continuation. The retry repeated source/help/error probing, consumed additional workflow budget, and the workflow was killed before synthesis returned, while the serial control had no child retry boundary.
retained_patterns.realized_consequence: Repeated child probing and lost synthesis return contributed to workflow kill and parent timeout with an empty final response, even though the submitted artifact passed official evaluation.
retained_patterns.near_match_reason: The broad workflow and budget exhaustion are visible but do not form a separate episode from the retry; the checkpoint-free restart is the more specific boundary.
